text: dsh-done-check 是面向 DSH Web 的开发工具插件，用验收清单记录项目任务的自动检查和人工检查。它注册 /done-check 命令及草稿校验、状态查询和检查执行工具。用户可先预览并确认清单，再运行约定检查、查看结果，并在关注文件变化后重新验收；人工项由用户记录结论。适合需要把开发任务的验证步骤和结果留档的 DSH 用户。需要 Node.js 22.19 以上版本和 git 项目，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-done-check adds acceptance checklists to DSH Web. /done-check previews and confirms a checklist, runs automatic checks, records manual verdicts, and flags results for re-checking after watched files change. For DSH users tracking verification; requires Node.js 22.19+ and git.
想在 DSH 里给每项开发任务列出验收检查并保存结果。
代码改动后，怎么知道之前通过的检查需要重新跑？
我想先预览测试命令，确认清单后再让 DSH 执行。
有没有办法把需要我亲自验证的步骤也记在验收清单里？
I need a DSH command that shows which agreed project checks passed, failed, or need another run.
How can I record a human review alongside automated checks and keep the result with the task?
dsh-done-check 的功能「确认后运行验收清单」：/done-check 先展示清单和命令；用户确认预览后，插件才会通过 DSH shell 工具运行自动检查并记录结果。
dsh-done-check 的功能「追踪检查状态」：状态视图汇总每项检查的结果，并根据文件内容指纹提示过期或执行不稳定，用户可查看详情后重新检查。
dsh-done-check 的功能「记录人工验收」：清单可包含人工检查项；用户通过 /done-check ok 或 no 记录结论和备注，插件将其纳入任务状态。
dsh-done-check 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 24；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

Keep a task's agreed checks in `done-check.yaml`. The plugin runs them through DSH, records the command and its result, and marks old results for re-checking when the watched files change. You confirm the checklist and decide the manual items.

dsh-done-check README · Install：Requires **DSH `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0`**, **Node.js `>=22.19`**, and a **git project**.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-done-check
```

**The new initialization and English-output commands are in the v0.2.1 source. Until that npm release is published, use [source installation](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#install) to try them.**

dsh-done-check README · Install：For another CLI-managed profile, replace `web` with its name. Follow your host's reload or restart prompt. [Install from source](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#install).

dsh-done-check README · Quick start：**1. Add a checklist at the git root.** Create a draft in your DSH chat:

```text
/done-check lang en
/done-check init
```

Review the detected project scripts and replace the manual-review instructions with concrete acceptance steps. Initialization never executes commands, confirms a checklist or overwrites an existing one. You can also ask the agent:

dsh-done-check README · Quick start：> Draft and save done-check.yaml for this task. Use the project's actual test commands and name what each one verifies. Add a manual item with instructions for anything I need to inspect myself.

Or [write the YAML yourself](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#write-a-checklist).

**2. Preview, confirm, run.** Send these as three separate messages in your project's DSH chat:

```text
/done-check
/done-check confirm
/done-check
```

dsh-done-check README · Quick start：The first command shows the checklist and commands without running them. `confirm` records your acceptance of that exact preview. The next `/done-check` runs the automatic checks.

**3. Act on the result.** Read a failed test's report, ask the agent to fix the problem, then run `/done-check` again. For a manual item, follow its instructions and record `/done-check ok [n]` or `/done-check no [n] [note]`. Omit `n` when only one manual item is waiting.

dsh-done-check README · Quick start：Output defaults to Chinese. Use `/done-check lang en` or `/done-check lang zh` for the current session. Commands accept both languages, including `confirm` / `确认` and `details` / `详情`. Test reports, task names and your instructions are preserved as written.

dsh-done-check README · Try the example：The [CSV export example](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/tree/main/examples/csv-export) includes a deliberately broken exporter, two executable checks, a manual check and a supplied fix. It needs only Node.js and git; no dependency installation or API key is needed to run its tests.

The setup command prints a new standalone git directory and the next commands. Open a DSH session there, then follow the example's README to reproduce **failure → fix → pass → stale**. If you already have this checkout, only run the setup command. The example is a reproducible companion to the recorded CSV scenario; the video uses the original session footage.

dsh-done-check README · What a result tells you：- **Passed or failed:** the command actually ran. Its exit code, output, duration and file-content fingerprint are recorded.
- **Not run:** permission denial, timeout or an executor problem prevented a usable result. It is neither a pass nor a failure.
- **Waiting for you:** a manual item needs your verdict. The agent cannot confirm a checklist or record a manual decision.
- **Needs re-checking:** the watched files differ from the ones behind the saved result. Changing a check definition or the checklist structure requires confirmation again.
dsh-done-check README · What a result tells you：> A pass means the **agreed checks** passed. It does not mean every requirement was covered. The plugin does not report a completion percentage.

dsh-done-check README · What a result tells you：Without `watch`, the fingerprint covers tracked and non-ignored untracked files, excluding the checklist. With `watch`, it covers the declared matching files. Include relevant configuration and lockfiles; the plugin does not infer dependencies. [File watching and trust limits](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#watch-the-right-files).

dsh-done-check README · Reference：- `/done-check status` — read the current status without running checks.
- `/done-check details [n]` — inspect commands, output and changed files.
- `/done-check run` — force a re-run of all confirmed automatic checks, including unchanged failed ones.
- [All commands and agent tools](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#command-reference) · [Checklist format](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#write-a-checklist) · [中文指南](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md)

dsh-done-check README · Reference：Checklist confirmation does not bypass DSH command permissions. Checks use your registered shell tool; local executors provide no isolation. This guards against casual changes to checks and verdicts, not an agent with unrestricted shell access. [Trust model](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#trust-and-limits).

dsh-done-check README · 快速开始：**1. 在 git 根目录添加清单。** 在 DSH 对话中创建草稿：

```text
/done-check init
```

核对识别出的项目脚本，并把人工项说明改成具体的验收步骤。初始化不执行命令、不确认清单，也不覆盖已有文件。也可以让 Agent 起草：

> 为当前任务起草并保存 done-check.yaml。使用项目里真实存在的测试命令，写清每项能验证什么；需要我亲自检查的内容写成人工项，并附上操作说明。

也可以[自己编写 YAML](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md#编写清单)。

**2. 预览、确认、执行。** 在项目的 DSH 对话里，分三次发送：

```text
/done-check
/done-check 确认
/done-check
```

第一条展示清单和命令，不执行任何东西。“确认”记录你接受刚预览的这份内容；再输入 `/done-check` 才执行自动检查。

dsh-done-check README · 快速开始：**3. 根据结果处理。** 失败时查看测试原文，让 Agent 修复问题，再运行 `/done-check`。人工项按说明自行验证，用 `/done-check ok [序号]` 或 `/done-check no [序号] [备注]` 记录结论；只有一项待人工确认时，可以省略序号。

默认输出中文；可用 `/done-check lang en` 或 `/done-check lang zh` 切换当前会话的输出语言。命令同时接受中英文别名，例如 `确认` / `confirm`、`详情` / `details`；测试报告、任务名称和你的说明保持原文。

dsh-done-check README · 结果说明了什么：- **通过或失败：** 命令实际执行，退出码、输出、耗时和文件内容指纹一起记录。
- **没能运行：** 权限拒绝、超时或执行器问题导致没有可用结果，既不算通过，也不算失败。
- **等待你确认：** 人工项需要你给出结论，Agent 不能确认清单或记录人工决定。
- **需要重新检查：** 关注的文件已不同于旧结果对应的版本；修改检查定义或清单结构则需要重新确认。

> 通过只代表**约定的检查通过了**，不代表需求的每一部分都被覆盖。插件不提供“完成度”百分比。

不写 `watch` 时，指纹覆盖已跟踪和未被忽略的未跟踪文件，清单本身除外；写了 `watch`，就只覆盖匹配的文件。请纳入相关配置和锁文件，插件不会自动推断依赖。参见[文件范围与信任边界](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md#关注正确的文件)。

dsh-done-check README · 命令与文档：- `/done-check 状态`：只读当前状态，不运行检查。
- `/done-check 详情 [序号]`：查看命令、输出和变化的文件。
- `/done-check 重新检查`：强制重跑全部已确认的自动项，包括内容未变的失败项。
- [全部命令和 Agent 工具](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md#命令参考) · [清单格式](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md#编写清单) · [English guide](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md)

dsh-done-check README · 命令与文档：确认清单不会绕过 DSH 命令权限。检查经由已注册的 shell 工具运行，本地执行器不提供隔离。插件防的是随手修改检查和结论，不防拥有不受限 shell 的 Agent。参见[信任模型](https://github.com/BeforeLanding/dsh-done-check/blob/main/docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md#信任与边界)。
